collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager laughs without thinking when a quiet friend says they would like to learn to drum.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) confides that (friend.he/she) would like to learn to drum for the festivals. (subject), without thinking, laughs. Not because it's funny: (subject) just pictured (friend), who is always so quiet, banging away on a big drum, and the laugh came out before (subject.he/she) could catch it. (friend)'s face falls.

choices.label: Let the Moment Pass and Make It Up Later

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I'm sorry," says (subject) quickly. "That wasn't at you. I just never pictured it, and now I can, and I think you'd be wonderful." (friend) isn't sure whether to believe (subject.him/her). (subject) doesn't push. A few days later (subject.he/she) finds (friend) practicing behind the huts, and quietly sits down to listen. (friend) doesn't stop.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) changes the subject, but the laugh sits between them all afternoon. That evening (subject) brings (friend) a small hollow log, perfect for practicing on. "I'm sorry I laughed," (subject.he/she) says. "I was surprised, that's all. I'd like to hear you play." (friend) takes the log. (friend.He/She) doesn't say (friend.he/she) forgives (subject.him/her) yet. But (friend.he/she) keeps the log.
